news.title: SpaceX、OpenAI和Anthropic有望重启IPO市场
news.snippet: SpaceX秘密IPO文件及AI巨头上市计划或将重新激活公开市场融资通道。
news.raw_snippet: SpaceX’s confidential [IPO filing](https://fortune.com/2026/04/02/can-elon-musk-take-spacex-ipo-to-infinity-and-beyond/?utm_source=search&utm_medium=suggested_search&utm_campaign=search_link_clicks) has Wall Street abuzz about a reopening for [high-growth tech debuts](https://fortune.com/2026/03/20/spacex-openai-anthropic-could-be-3-of-the-biggest-venture-backed-ipos-of-all-time/?utm_source=search&utm_medium=suggested_search&utm_campaign=search_link_clicks), with OpenAI and Anthropic also looming in the wings. Despite the hype, the IPO market that [awaits](https://fortune.com/2026/01/15/ipo-boom-stock-market-nvidia-blackrock-spacex-openai-investing/?utm_source=search&utm_medium=suggested_search&utm_campaign=search_link_clicks) them looks nothing like 2021’s stampede. New Crunchbase [data](https://news.crunchbase.com/venture/record-breaking-funding-ai-global-q1-2026/) shows investors poured about $300 billion into roughly 6,000 startups globally in the quarter, up more than 150% both quarter over quarter and year over year. The market [began to stabilize](https://www.ey.com/en_ie/newsroom/2026/01/global-ipo-market-stabilises-in-2025-while-2026-pipeline-signals-potential-ai-led-mega-wave) in 2025: Global IPOs totaled 1,293 deals raising about $171.8 billion, a 39% increase in proceeds year over year, and the pipeline for 2026 turned more optimistic as larger tech names like Chime and Klarna finally got out. - [**Xoople**](https://www.xoople.com/), a Madrid, Spain-based AI data infrastructure company, raised $130 million in Series B funding from **Nazca** **Capital**, **MCH**, **CDTI**, **Buenavista** **Equity** **Partners**, **Endeavor** **Catalyst**, and others. - [**Natter**](https://www.trynatter.com/), a New York City-based AI conversation intelligence platform, raised $23 million in funding.

news.title: AI时代的估值逻辑 - Asymco
news.snippet: Asymco探讨人工智能时代企业价值的精确衡量标准与新型估值方法论。
news.raw_snippet: This is the precise and complete measure of the firm’s value but we use the shortcut of Market Cap since In most cases the Preferred stock and minority interest are negligible and if cash equals debt then the result is EV =~ Market Cap. it’s easier to calculate anyways as the shares outstanding and share price are easily available. When dividing both Market Cap and Earnings by the number of shares it becomes the famous P/E ratio or Price per share / Earnings per share. I used EV/FCF years ago to value Apple because at a time when it held huge amounts of cash. Without worrying who is or isn’t in the “Magnificent 7” I compiled the largest 10 market capitalization companies and looked at their P/E and EV/FCF ratios. | **Company** | **Market Cap** | **P/E Ratio** | **EV/FCF** |. The table above shows how much more elevated the EV/FCF ratio is relative to P/E for many of the companies.

news.title: AI创始人青睐零经验Z世代，称其具备独特优势
news.snippet: AI公司创始人表示，尽管缺乏经验，Gen Z在AI原生思维方面具有不可替代优势。
news.raw_snippet: # This AI founder is hiring Gen Z with zero experience because they’re not stuck in ‘old ways of working’—even as other CEOs slash entry‑level roles. “There are some positions where you actually want people that do not have the prejudice or the old way of working,” Chen tells *Fortune*. In the past few years, there’s been an explosion of new tools, job functions, and ways of working thanks to AI. “When you come as someone who just sees the problem and finds the best way to solve it,” Chen says, “it’s sometimes better than someone who has been doing the same job for so long and may just try to redo what’s been working for them in the past.”. To be clear: Chen isn’t *only* hiring Gen Z. He adds, “I think there is actually an opportunity for younger people, if they are resourceful and can actually flag in some way that they’re better than others, and more determined to succeed than others.”.
